questiontext.text:
The prism has a triangular cross-section and a length as shown below. Calculate it's volume

[[jsxgraph]] var board = JXG.JSXGraph.initBoard('jxgbox', { boundingbox: [-50, 300, 500, -50], keepAspectRatio: true, axis: false, showCopyright: false }); var A = board.create('point',[100,100],{visible:false}); var B = board.create('point',[250,100],{visible:false}); var C = board.create('point',[100,220],{visible:false}); var D = board.create('point',[300,130],{visible:false}); var E = board.create('point',[450,130],{visible:false}); var F = board.create('point',[300,250],{visible:false}); board.create('polygon',[A,B,C],{ fillColor:'cyan', fillOpacity:0.5, vertices:{visible:false} }); board.create('polygon',[D,E,F],{ fillColor:'cyan', fillOpacity:0.5, vertices:{visible:false} }); board.create('segment',[A,D]); board.create('segment',[B,E]); board.create('segment',[C,F]); board.create('text',[150,80,'{#b#} cm']); board.create('text',[60,160,'{#h#} cm']); board.create('text',[200,140,'{#L#} cm']); [[/jsxgraph]]

Volume = [[input:ans1]] cm3

[[validation:ans1]] [[feedback:prt1]]

generalfeedback.text:
Worked solution

The volume of a rectangular prism is calculated by multiplying its three dimensions:

\(V=l\times w\times h\)

For this question:

  • Length = \({@l@}\) cm
  • Width = \({@w@}\) cm
  • Height = \({@h@}\) cm

Substituting the values:

\(V={@l@}\times{@w@}\times{@h@}\)

\(V={@ta@}\text{ cm}^3\)

Good attempt but your answer is incorrect! Seems you used the wrong triangle\(b*h/2\) area for calculating the volume

The correct formula for area of a triangles is:

triangle_area: \((b*h)/2\)
